803-7487-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
803-7487-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Arcane Adaptation, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Zealous Lorecaster token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1116-1939-4279--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1116-1939-4279--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Luminous Phantom, Sek'Kuar and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Luminous Phantom trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Sek'Kuar ability, creating a 3/1 Graveborn creature token with haste.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Luminous Phantom triggers, causing you to gain 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

2556-4826-5531-5694-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
2556-4826-5531-5694-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Mnemonic Wall and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Mnemonic Wall and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Mnemonic Wall trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Repeat.
2556-4826-5531-5694-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Mnemonic Wall and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

856-1379-4247-6748-6757.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar by paying {B}.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it and Weapons Manufacturing trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Weapons Manufacturing trigger, creating a Munitions artifact token.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing the Munitions, as it is a Food due to Ragost.
The Munitions triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

849-2738-4871-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Anax, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Anax trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1.
Repeat.

215-1902-7296.notablePrerequisites: There are at least six Elves on the battlefield.
215-1902-7296.description:
Activate Wirewood Channeler by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Wirewood Channeler from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Wirewood Channeler by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2349-4377-7722.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost.
Thor's second ability triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve Walk the Aeons, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Blink Thor using Mistmeadow Witch.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Walk the Aeons from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Walk the Aeons from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

3259-6633-7603.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control that has base power 0.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-6633-7603.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Primo.
Resolve the Primo trigger, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token that enters with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the damage dealt.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and attach it to the Fractal token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

206-3259-4373.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
206-3259-4373.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Ghalta and Mavren as attackers.
Ghalta and Mavren triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
206-3259-4373.notes: Either Ghalta and Mavren ability can be used.

4217-4924-7302.description:
Cast Whirlwind Technique by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Lutri by paying its mana cost reduced by Heartless Summoning.
When Lutri enters, it triggers, copying Whirlwind Technique targeting Lutri.
Resolve Whirlwind Technique, airbending Lutri.
Holding priority, cast Lutri from exile by paying {0} due to Heartless Summoning.
Repeat from step 3.

3767-3918-5527-7223.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Clues.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

647-1563-3899-6705.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

969-1563-3490-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
969-1563-3490-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 5 or greater

3750-7016-7024.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Firebending Student.
3750-7016-7024.description:
Declare Firebending Student as an attacker, triggering its ability, adding an amount of {R} equal to its power.
Move to your postcombat main phase. You will not lose the mana due to Upwelling.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

1558-2334-6741.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five multicolored permanents plus either another multicolored permanent or another creature with power 1 or greater if Soulherder's power is 1.
1558-2334-6741.description:
Cast Infinite Guideline Station either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Infinite Guideline Station enters, it triggers, creating a 2/2 Robot artifact creature token for each multicolored permanent you control.
Activate Infinite Guideline Station's station ability by tapping any number of creatures with total power 12 or greater, putting at least twelve charge counters on Infinite Guideline Station, causing it to become a creature.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Robots, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Soulherder triggers, blinking Infinite Guideline Station.
When Infinite Guideline Station enters, it and Soulherder trigger.
Resolve the Infinite Guideline Station trigger, creating a 2/2 Robot artifact creature token for each multicolored permanent you control.
Resolve the Soulherder trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 3 each turn.

1315-3678-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1315-3678-6879.description:
Play a land.
When the land enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters, Haru triggers, earthbending the land that entered.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing the earthbended land.
Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters, Haru triggers, earthbending the land that entered.
Resolve the Zuran Orb ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.

643-703-4050-4394.description:
Cast Everquill Phoenix for its mutate cost by paying {3}{R}, mutating it over or under a non-Human creature you control.
Everquill Phoenix triggers, creating a Feather artifact token.
Cast Astral Dragon by paying {6}{U}{U}.
When Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two copies of the Feather token that are 3/3 Dragon creatures.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Astral Dragon, adding {1}.
Activate a Feather by paying {1} and sacrificing it, returning Astral Dragon from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.

2498-3591-5435-6282.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2498-3591-5435-6282.description:
Activate Dream Trawler by discarding a card.
Necropotence triggers, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Sheoldred triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Dream Trawler ability.
Repeat.

2452-2511-2577.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional Zombie.
2452-2511-2577.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Repeat.

3373-4141.description:
Cast Blood Tribute by paying {4}{B}{B} and optionally choosing to tap a Vampire, causing an opponent to lose half their life total, rounded up, and causing you to gain life equal to the life lost this way if you paid the kicker cost.
At the beginning of your end step, Astarion triggers, causing an opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.

372-864-2072.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Scrollshift exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-864-2072.description:
Cast Scrollshift by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Eternal Witness and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Eternal Witness trigger.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Scrollshift from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Scrollshift.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Eternal Witness and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

2921-3652-5220-5683.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Ornithopter.
When Ornithopter dies, Mortuary and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Ornithopter from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, searching your library for Ornithopter and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Repeat.

413-2178-2527-3143.notablePrerequisites:
There is at least one counter on a permanent you control except Xavier Sal.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Xavier Sal.
You control at least one additional nontoken Human, Fungus and/or Pirate that has no more than one +1/+1 counter on it.
413-2178-2527-3143.description:
Activate Xavier Sal's first ability by tapping it and removing a +1/+1 counter from the additional nontoken Human, Fungus and/or Pirate if it has one, or any counter from another permanent you control otherwise.
Xavier Sal triggers, causing it and all other creatures you control that share a creature type with it to get +2/+0 and gain undying until end of turn.
Resolve the Xavier Sal ability, causing you to populate.
If you created a creature token, Blasting Station triggers when the token enters the battlefield, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the additional Human, Fungus and/or Pirate.
When the creature dies, its undying ability and Xavier Sal trigger.
Resolve the creature's undying trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Xavier Sal trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

38-392-3705-5465.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Repeat.

1651-3715-4772-5365.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one counter on a permanent you control.
1651-3715-4772-5365.description:
Activate Power Conduit by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, putting two +1/+1 counters on Lonis.
Lonis' second ability triggers, creating four Clue artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Clues, untapping Power Conduit.
Repeat.

321-877-4740.notablePrerequisites:
"Sliver" chosen with Morophon.
Your life total is at least two, or you have cast at least one spell this turn.
321-877-4740.description:
Cast Hibernation Sliver by paying {0} due to Morophon.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Activate Hibernation Sliver by paying 2 life, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite life, you may activate Aetherflux Reservoir to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

1088-3602-4050-4929.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Persistent Specimen, adding {B}.
When Persistent Specimen dies, Bhaal triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite and goading it.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Persistent Specimen by paying {2}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

1766-1978-5089.description:
Animate Thran Dynamo using Karn, the Great Creator.
Activate Thran Dynamo by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Thran Dynamo.
Repeat from step 2.

Tap 2 mana to activate mirror, targeting grinning ignus.

tap mirror for 5 mana before letting it become an ignus.
Use one mana to return mirror to your hand using ignus's ability.
this adds 3 to your mana pool.
8 floating.
